Randomize the order of Snooze and Stop each time an alert rings.
Press a volume key during a full-screen alert to snooze.

Turn off the screen while the alert is ringing to snooze.

Alarms, countdowns and Pomodoro share these settings. Allow notifications, exact alarms and full-screen alerts, and keep the alert channel at high importance. While using the phone, Android may show a banner instead.
HyperOS / MIUI: if lock-screen alerts are blocked, check Show on Lock screen, background pop-up windows, autostart and background battery limits in system app settings. Names vary by OS version.

ColorOS / OnePlus / realme: if alerts are delayed or hidden on the lock screen, check lock-screen notifications, background activity and autostart in system app settings. Options depend on the OS version.
